title: Dark Stripped Heavy
style: post-punk grunge, 140 BPM, stripped back raw production, heavy distorted guitar, minimalist drums, dark energy, male vocal NZ/AU accent raw and direct, no polish intentional, short sharp hooks, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1 — short, punchy, raw]
No reverb
No safety net
Just the riff and what it meant
No producer — no clean mix
Just the song and what it is

[CHORUS]
Dark stripped heavy — that's it
Dark stripped heavy — legit
Dark stripped heavy — no tricks
Dark stripped heavy — no fix

[VERSE 2]
1997 — no release
2026 — the peace
30 years and finally out
That's what this was all about

[BRIDGE — single guitar, voice only]
Stripped.
To the thing it always was.
Before anyone touched it.
Before anyone said anything.
Just this.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Dark stripped heavy — the vault
Dark stripped heavy — not your fault
Dark stripped heavy — the real
Dark stripped heavy — finally feel

[OUTRO — guitar alone, fades]
